Senior QA Engineer

Raccoon City · Full-time

Umbrella Corp is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to lead test automation across our research platforms. You will work closely with developers and product managers.

You will own the end-to-end test suite, set quality gates in CI, and mentor two junior engineers on testing practices and tooling choices.

  • 5+ years in QA, at least 3 in automation
  • Playwright or Cypress
  • Comfort with API testing and contract tests
